sentences.text: Neogyps is a member of the family Accipitridae, which includes hawks and eagles, and belongs to the subfamily Aegypiinae.
The genus is defined by the type species Neogyps errans.
Despite being grouped with Old World vultures, this animal lived in the New World.
Scientists have identified six distinct fossil occurrences of this species.
Remains were discovered in western North America, specifically at the La Brea Tar Pits in southern California.
Fossils date primarily to the Late Pleistocene, spanning from the Chibanian to 0.0117 million years ago.
